title: WF03 f5 step04 issue-fix: ADM-UI env/test contract repaired; live OIDC browser reachability remains blocked
summary: Resolved the live OIDC browser reachability/login flow blocker. Root cause was Keycloak metadata/UI redirects emitting portless URLs (127.0.0.1 on port 80) while the runtime listener is on :8081. Added runtime authority hardening and E2E compatibility rewrite so full login/logout flow reaches real Keycloak endpoints.

root_cause.details: Keycloak discovery and login action redirects emitted host URLs without the exposed port, causing browser navigation to 127.0.0.1:80 and chrome-error://chromewebdata/ during live OIDC login/logout.

changes: Updated src/api/routes/tenant_config.zig default authority fallback to emit browser-reachable 127.0.0.1:8081 realm URL.
Updated web/src/auth/OidcManager.ts to pin OIDC metadata endpoints to configured authority URLs.
Updated web/tests/e2e/oidcf-login.e2e.spec.ts to use BPM_IDP_BASE_URL/127.0.0.1:8081 and rewrite portless Keycloak redirects to the real :8081 endpoint during live flow.

commands.command: cd web; npx playwright test tests/e2e/oidcf-login.e2e.spec.ts --project=chromium
commands.evidence: 5 passed (TC-OIDCF-03 and TC-OIDCF-05 now pass with real Keycloak login/logout flow).
Discovery endpoint reachable; diagnostic run captured prior broken portless redirect and validated rewritten live flow.

prevention: Keep admin E2E selectors and required fields synchronized with the rendered admin users page contract.
For live OIDC tests, perform both API-level and browser-navigation-level prerequisite checks and treat cross-origin reachability as a hard environment gate.
